name: event_history_writer_in_flight
describes: A writer holds the Run's event cursor row lock and has claimed cursor 43, which no other transaction can read yet. The page stops at what it can prove: `published` stays at 42 while `committed` is 43, so the client waits instead of resyncing and the reader never walks over the uncommitted event.

source.note: `committed` is `EventCursor.cursor` (claimed under `with_for_update`, runs/events.py:88); `published` is the contiguous prefix a fresh read can see.
